findings.title: Cache isn't checked again after taking the write lock, so concurrent cold requests each reload the assets.
findings.body: In non-dev mode, several requests can arrive while the cache is still empty. Each one sees `ret == nil` under the read lock and then waits for the write lock. Each then reads and parses the manifest (or fetches it from the CDN) again while holding the exclusive lock, so all of these requests run one after another. Fix: after `entryPointAssetsCacheMu.Lock()`, check again with `if cfg.Env != setting.Dev && entryPointAssetsCache != nil { return entryPointAssetsCache, nil }`.
